analyst.summary: Caplin Point is a highly profitable, debt-free pharmaceutical company selling formulations mainly into Latin America and Africa, with excellent margins (33-35%) and returns on capital (~20-26%). Growth has been steady but moderate (low-to-mid teens) and is decelerating quarter to quarter, and working-capital and collection-day metrics have worsened noticeably over the past year -- a real item to watch, even if not yet a clear problem. We rate it a Hold: an excellent-quality, debt-free business, but not currently accelerating, and the working-capital trend deserves scrutiny before being dismissed as normal emerging-market business practice.
